NJ-senate.statusNote: Sen. Cory Booker (D), seeking a third full term, faces attorney and Navy veteran Justin Murphy (R), who won the June 2 primary with 33%.

candidates.name: Cory Booker
candidates.background: U.S. Senator since 2013 and former Mayor of Newark; ran for president in 2020. In 2025 he delivered the longest speech in Senate history (25 hours 5 minutes). Former tenants' rights lawyer.
priorities: Economic justice: baby bonds, EITC and child tax credit

cost.label: Targets 'the soaring cost of rent and predatory practices like overdraft fees'; championed EITC/child tax credit expansion (Senate issues)

health.label: Calls health care a fundamental human right; leader in protecting and building on the ACA (Senate issues)

housing.label: Made rental affordability a priority, 'cracking down on the soaring cost of rent' (Senate issues)

immigration.label: Backs protections for undocumented spouses and DACA recipients; urges comprehensive reform (Senate release)

taxes.label: Championed EITC/child tax credit expansion; authored 'baby bonds' seed-money-at-birth legislation (Senate issues)

climate.label: Original Green New Deal cosponsor; frames climate as an equity issue; lead on plastics reduction (Senate issues)

education.label: RAISE Act for up to $15,000 in teacher-pay tax credits; 'a student's zip code should not determine' their trajectory (Senate issues)

safety.label: Authored the First Step Act; works to end mass incarceration, reform sentencing, improve reentry (Senate issues)

repro.label: Introduced legislation affirming FDA preemption to protect medication-abortion access nationwide (Senate issues)

democracy.label: Co-led the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act: 'the right to vote is sacred for all Americans' (Senate release)

candidates.name: Justin Murphy
candidates.background: Attorney and Navy veteran who enlisted at 17 and served during the Iran-Iraq War era; a former Tabernacle Township committeeman and deputy mayor. Won the June Republican primary with 33% on his second Senate try.

cost.label: Middle-class economic security via a 10-12% flat tax, low interest rates, protecting seniors' Medicare (campaign site)

health.label: Opposes government-run health care; universal coverage via mandatory Health Savings Accounts and national market competition (campaign site)

immigration.label: Complete the border wall, defund sanctuary cities, station the military at the border against cartels (campaign site)

taxes.label: Abolish the IRS; 10-12% flat income tax; eliminate capital gains and estate taxes (campaign site)

climate.label: Energy independence via shale oil and nuclear expansion; keep the Jersey Shore 'windmill free' (campaign site)

education.label: Eliminate the federal Dept. of Education and redirect funds to local boards and vouchers (campaign site)

safety.label: Stop fentanyl at the border, deport criminal offenders, federal prosecution where local enforcement fails (campaign site)

repro.label: Pro-life with rape, incest, and mother's-health exceptions; opposes taxpayer-funded abortion (campaign site)
